title: Cyber Defense: Network Wars
description: Command your cybersecurity team to defend a corporate network against a ruthless hacker collective! Deploy firewalls, encrypt data channels, run penetration tests, and set honeypot traps. Every move teaches real network security concepts — from firewalls and encryption to zero-day exploits and phishing attacks. Control critical network nodes to secure your infrastructure before the hackers breach your defenses.
learning_objectives: Understand how firewalls, IDS, and SIEM systems protect networks
Learn about common attack vectors: phishing, ransomware, trojans, zero-day exploits
Understand the role of encryption in data protection
Learn how honeypots and penetration testing improve security
Develop risk assessment and incident response skills
how_to_play: Each turn you get 2 Action Points (AP). Moving a piece costs 1 AP, using a special ability costs 1 AP.
Your Firewall is the king — if it's captured, your network is breached and you lose!

SIEM Analyst moves like a queen (any direction, any distance). IDS Scanner moves like a rook (straight lines). Encryption moves like a bishop (diagonals). Pentester moves like a knight (L-shaped jumps). Honeypots move like pawns (forward only).
Capture enemy pieces by moving onto their square. Honeypots promote to SIEM Analysts when reaching the last row.
Control network nodes by placing pieces on them. Each node generates security score per turn.
Win by: capturing the enemy Botnet C2, controlling 3+ network nodes, or reaching 10M security score.
objectives: Capture the enemy Botnet C2 server to shut down the attack
Control 3 or more critical network nodes
Build your security score to 10 million

storybook_pages.title: Welcome to Cyber Defense
storybook_pages.text: A sophisticated hacker collective has launched a coordinated attack on your corporate network. Botnets, ransomware, phishing campaigns — they're using every tool in their arsenal. As the head of cybersecurity, you must deploy your defense team strategically to protect critical infrastructure.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: futuristic cybersecurity command center with holographic screens showing network maps, a team of security analysts working, blue and green neon lights, digital shield icons, dramatic lighting, cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Know Your Tools
storybook_pages.text: Your team includes Firewalls to block attacks, SIEM analysts to detect threats across the entire network, IDS scanners to monitor traffic, Encryption specialists to protect data, Pentesters who think like hackers to find vulnerabilities first, and Honeypots that lure attackers into traps.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: cybersecurity tools illustrated as characters: a shield (firewall), a magnifying glass (SIEM), a radar dish (IDS), a lock (encryption), a hacker in white hat (pentester), a honey jar trap (honeypot), colorful cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Defend the Network
storybook_pages.text: Control the critical network nodes — server rooms, databases, and API gateways. Each node you secure strengthens your defense. But beware: the hackers have their own arsenal of malware, exploits, and social engineering attacks. Think strategically, anticipate attacks, and protect what matters most.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: network map with glowing nodes connected by lines, some nodes protected by shields (blue), others under attack by red malware icons, chess-like grid overlay, dramatic cyberpunk style, cartoon

strengths.name: Traffic Filter
strengths.desc: Blocks all unauthorized access attempts. Enemies attacking the Firewall deal -1 damage.

strengths.name: Rule Engine
strengths.desc: All adjacent friendly pieces gain +1 ATK from optimized firewall rules.

strengths.name: Always On
strengths.desc: Generates 50,000 Security Score per turn just by being alive on the board.

weaknesses.name: High-Value Target
weaknesses.desc: If the Firewall is captured, your entire network is breached — game over!

weaknesses.name: Limited Mobility
weaknesses.desc: Can only move 1 square in any direction, making repositioning slow.

weaknesses.name: Configuration Drift
weaknesses.desc: If surrounded by 3+ enemy pieces, the Firewall loses 1 HP per turn from misconfigurations.

abilities.name: Block Traffic
abilities.desc: Activate deep packet inspection — all adjacent friendly pieces gain +2 ATK this turn.

abilities.name: Emergency Patch
abilities.desc: Deploy a critical security patch — reveals all enemy piece abilities and stats for 2 turns.

strengths.name: Full Visibility
strengths.desc: Moves any direction, any distance — monitors the entire network from a single console.

strengths.name: Correlation Engine
strengths.desc: Gains +2 ATK when attacking Pentesters or Honeypots due to advanced threat correlation.

strengths.name: Threat Intel
strengths.desc: Cannot be pushed or displaced by enemy abilities — anchored by real-time intelligence feeds.

weaknesses.name: Alert Fatigue
weaknesses.desc: If no friendly pieces are within 2 squares, the SIEM suffers -1 ATK from information overload.

weaknesses.name: Log Overflow
weaknesses.desc: After using an ability, all abilities cost +1 AP next turn due to log processing overhead.

weaknesses.name: False Positives
weaknesses.desc: Cannot remain on the same tile for 2 consecutive turns — must reposition to recalibrate.

abilities.name: Deep Scan
abilities.desc: Perform a deep network scan — teleport to any empty tile within 3 squares.

abilities.name: Incident Response
abilities.desc: Initiate incident response protocol — heal self for +3 HP.

strengths.name: Signature Match
strengths.desc: Moves in straight lines with no distance limit — scans entire rows and columns for threats.

strengths.name: Packet Capture
strengths.desc: When capturing an enemy piece, gain bonus Security Score income equal to the target's value.

strengths.name: Network Tap
strengths.desc: Cannot be captured while adjacent to a controlled resource node — protected by network monitoring.

weaknesses.name: Blind Diagonals
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move diagonally — vulnerable to attacks from Encryption and other diagonal threats.

weaknesses.name: Bandwidth Drain
weaknesses.desc: Loses 1 HP per turn if not adjacent to a resource node — needs network bandwidth to operate.

weaknesses.name: Tunnel Vision
weaknesses.desc: Must move at least 2 squares when moving — cannot make small adjustments.

abilities.name: Alert Scan
abilities.desc: Deploy network probes — gain immediate income from any adjacent resource node.

abilities.name: Block IP
abilities.desc: Blacklist a malicious IP — weaken any enemy piece within 3 squares by -2 ATK for 1 turn.

strengths.name: Diagonal Control
strengths.desc: Moves diagonally across the network — launches cross-network encryption attacks.

strengths.name: Cipher Strength
strengths.desc: All enemy pieces adjacent to Encryption have -1 ATK — weakened by strong ciphers.

strengths.name: Key Exchange
strengths.desc: Pushing an enemy piece into another enemy piece damages both for 2 HP — collision from key exchange protocol.

weaknesses.name: No Direct Path
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move in straight lines — must always approach targets diagonally.

weaknesses.name: Key Dependency
weaknesses.desc: Suffers -2 ATK if your Security Score falls below 2,000,000 — weak keys from resource shortage.

weaknesses.name: Decryption Vulnerable
weaknesses.desc: Takes +1 extra damage from SIEM-type attacks — log analysis can break encryption patterns.

abilities.name: Encrypt Channel
abilities.desc: Force-encrypt a data channel — push an enemy piece 2 squares away from current position.

abilities.name: Key Rotate
abilities.desc: Rotate encryption keys — swap positions with any friendly piece on the board.

strengths.name: Exploit Knowledge
strengths.desc: Moves in L-shaped patterns and jumps over other pieces — bypasses conventional defenses.

strengths.name: Zero-Day Discovery
strengths.desc: Gains +2 ATK when attacking from an unexpected angle — exploits unknown vulnerabilities.

strengths.name: Hardened Defense
strengths.desc: Takes -1 damage from all attacks — battle-tested from constant penetration testing.

weaknesses.name: Scope Limited
weaknesses.desc: Can only reach 8 possible squares from any position — restricted engagement scope.

weaknesses.name: Sprint Fatigue
weaknesses.desc: Cannot use abilities on two consecutive turns — needs cooldown between exploit attempts.

weaknesses.name: Engagement Rules
weaknesses.desc: Cannot return to the same position within 2 turns — rules of engagement prevent revisiting.

abilities.name: Vulnerability Scan
abilities.desc: Identify and patch a vulnerability — place a firewall blocker on any adjacent empty tile.

abilities.name: Exploit Chain
abilities.desc: Chain multiple exploits together — move twice in one turn. Costs all AP.

strengths.name: Threat Intel
strengths.desc: Gains +1 ATK for each turn survived on the board, stacking up to +3 — gathers attacker intelligence.

strengths.name: Disposable
strengths.desc: You deploy 8 Honeypots — losing one is acceptable if it reveals enemy tactics.

strengths.name: Promotion
strengths.desc: Reaching the last row of the board promotes a Honeypot into a full SIEM Analyst.

weaknesses.name: Forward Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only move forward one square at a time — no retreat from the front lines.

weaknesses.name: Low HP
weaknesses.desc: Only 3 HP — easily destroyed by any serious attack.

weaknesses.name: Diagonal Capture Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only capture enemy pieces diagonally — cannot attack straight ahead.

abilities.name: Lure
abilities.desc: Emit a fake vulnerability signal — heal an adjacent friendly piece for +3 HP.

abilities.name: Decoy Swap
abilities.desc: Switch positions with an adjacent friendly Honeypot to confuse attackers.

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.
